head.name: @fzlt/core/water
head.lead: Animated water for @fzlt/core/diorama scenes (a bay, a pond, a wave pool), lifted from the Salvo Bay prototype. water(d, { rect | outline, level, … }) builds the water's body (depth bands as prisms) and paints its surface in the diorama's depth sort: wave crests that roll across, a drifting sheen, foam lapping along the edges you pick, bow waves and wakes behind the objects you wake, and pooled effects: splash (a column of water, spray, a crown of drops, rings and ripples that travel out), ripple, bubbles and whirl (something going down). - The surface is a function: height(x, z, t) is the same for the same (x, z, t) on every run (sines of the wave, plus the optional swell: a travelling, peeling crest a surfer can ride, its slope and its crest position). Effects are seeded (seed), so a replay splashes the same. - It has its own clock: step(dt) moves it and returns busy. The idle roll runs idle seconds after the last effect or stir(), then rests, so the engine can settle; still (reduced motion, on by default when the page asks for it) freezes the surface and keeps every effect short. - Everything is clipped to the outline and drawn from fixed pools (particles, rings, whirls, bubble emitters, wake trails): no allocation per step or draw in the steady state; past a pool's capacity an effect is dropped, never grown. Wakes read the object's world matrix from the last draw. DOM-free (one matchMedia read for the still default); 2D lengths use steer's exact hypot.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.

blocks.label: IN SHORT
blocks.code:
const w = water(d, { rect: [-4, -3, 4, 3], level: 0.8, bands: [{ h: 0.3, color: "#4f8fb5" }] });
w.wake(boat); // bow waves and a trail that follow it
w.splash(x, z); // a column, spray, a crown of drops, rings: pooled, 0 allocations
e.add({ step: (_, dt) => w.step(dt) && e.busy(), render: () => d.draw() }); // rests, then settles
w.height(x, z); // the surface under a surfer, the same on every run
